patient_persona.description: Encik Yusri bin Kamal, 63, male, retired technician in Kuantan, newly started on warfarin after a mechanical heart valve. Attentive, asks many questions.

doctor_persona.description: Pn. Lee Siew Ting, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, pharmacist at a Kuantan hospital outpatient pharmacy counter. Clear, friendly; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Yusri, ini ubat warfarin encik. Saya nak terangkan sikit sebab ubat ni sangat penting dan perlu hati-hati.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, puan. Doktor cakap sebab injap jantung saya yang baru tu, the mechanical valve, kan?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Betul. Warfarin cegah darah beku kat injap. Encik makan 5mg, iaitu satu biji warna pink, sekali sehari, waktu yang sama setiap petang.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau terlupa satu hari, macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau ingat hari yang sama, makan. Kalau dah esok, langkau je, jangan makan dua biji sekaligus. Catat dalam buku warfarin ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Makanan pula ada pantang ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sayur hijau macam bayam, kangkung, pucuk paku ada vitamin K. Tak perlu elak, tapi makan jumlah yang konsisten, jangan tiba-tiba banyak sangat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya suka minum jus limau dan makan ulam-ulaman. Still can ah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh, dalam jumlah biasa. Yang perlu elak, ubat tradisional, jamu, dan suplemen tanpa tanya doktor. Banyak berinteraksi dengan warfarin.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Panadol boleh makan kalau sakit kepala?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Paracetamol boleh, dos biasa. Tapi ubat tahan sakit macam ibuprofen, diclofenac, atau aspirin, jangan makan. Bahaya berdarah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tanda berdarah macam mana, puan?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Gusi berdarah lama, lebam besar tanpa sebab, kencing merah, najis hitam, atau muntah darah. Kalau ada, terus ke hospital.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya kena check darah selalu ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, ujian INR. Minggu pertama dua kali, lepas stabil sebulan sekali, kat klinik warfarin. Target encik dua setengah ke tiga setengah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau pergi klinik gigi, perlu beritahu?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mesti beritahu, dan tunjuk kad warfarin ni. Simpan dalam dompet. Ada soalan lain, encik?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak ada, puan. Thank you, very clear.

condition: Pharmacy counselling on insulin pen technique

patient_persona.description: Mdm. Chew Ah Lan, 67, female, retired market vendor in Kluang, Johor, newly prescribed insulin; daughter accompanies. Nervous, worried about needles, Hokkien-flavoured Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Mr. Muhammad Aiman bin Rosli, Malay man in his 20s, pharmacist at a Kluang klinik kesihatan. Patient, cheerful; English with Mandarin and Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Auntie Chew, 你好. This is your insulin pen. Today I teach you how to inject, okay? 不用怕.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我很怕打针。医生说一定要打，tablet 不够了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The needle is very small, very thin. 很多人说比 finger prick 还不痛. Let me show you first.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: First, wash hands. 拿这个 pen, remove the cap. Put a new needle, screw it on like this.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 每次都要换新的 needle 吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, every time new needle. 旧的针会钝, more pain and can cause infection.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Next, turn the dial to 2 units, point up, press to see a drop at the tip. This is the priming, to remove air.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 看到一滴出来了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Now turn to your dose, 10 units. 捏起肚子的皮, two fingers away from belly button.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 肚子这边？不会很 pain 吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tummy fat is best, less pain. Push the needle straight in, press the button fully, 慢慢数到十, then pull out.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 一、二、三……十。咦，真的不太痛。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: See, auntie very brave! 每天换地方, left side, right side, so no lumps form.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 这个 insulin 要放冰箱吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: New pens, in the fridge, not freezer. 正在用的那支, keep at room temperature, up to 28 days. Don't leave in the car.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 如果太低，那个 hypo，要怎么办？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If shaking, sweating, very hungry, take three sweets or half glass of juice. Then check sugar after fifteen minutes. 你女儿也要知道.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我女儿有在听。Terima kasih, 年轻人。

condition: Pharmacy counselling on metered-dose inhaler and spacer

patient_persona.description: Mr. Rajkumar a/l Subramaniam, 45, male, factory supervisor in Prai, Penang, newly diagnosed with adult-onset asthma. Practical, a bit impatient, Manglish.

doctor_persona.description: Pn. Nur Syafiqah binti Azmi, Malay woman in her 30s, pharmacist at a Penang hospital outpatient pharmacy. Friendly, thorough; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Rajkumar, the doctor gave you two inhalers today. Saya terangkan which one is for what.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, but quick ah, I need to go back to factory. Parking also nak habis.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'll be quick. The brown one is budesonide-formoterol, Symbicort. That's your preventer, guna setiap hari, two puffs pagi dan malam.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Every day even when I'm not sesak?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, every day. It reduces swelling in your airways. Kalau guna masa sakit je, attacks will keep coming.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: And the blue one?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Blue one, salbutamol, Ventolin, only when you're wheezy or sesak nafas. Two puffs. If you need it more than twice a week, jumpa doktor.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, brown every day, blue when sesak. Got it.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Now show me how you use the blue one. Cuba tunjuk, here's a placebo.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Like this, shake, press and breathe in.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Almost. You pressed before breathing in. Banyak ubat melekat kat tekak je. Let's use the spacer, easier.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: The tube thing? Must bring everywhere ah? Bit leceh lah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: At home and office, the spacer is best. Goncang, attach, tekan sekali, then breathe in and out slowly five times.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, this one feels more masuk in the chest.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Exactly. For Symbicort, it's a Turbuhaler, tak payah goncang. Twist until click, breathe out away from it, then breathe in fast and deep.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Fast for brown, slow for blue. Okay, I remember.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: And after the brown one, kumur mulut dan buang. Otherwise can get fungal infection in the mouth.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Thank you, cik. Actually good you checked, I would've done it wrong.

condition: Pharmacy counselling on antibiotic course and oral contraceptive interaction query

patient_persona.description: Cik Nur Farahin binti Azmi, 24, female, university student in Shah Alam, prescribed amoxicillin for tonsillitis; on a combined pill. Friendly, a bit shy, Malay-English.

doctor_persona.description: Mr. Ong Kah Wai, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, community pharmacist at a Shah Alam pharmacy. Relaxed, clear; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cik Farahin, ini ubat dari klinik. Amoxicillin 500mg, one capsule three times a day, for seven days. Makan sampai habis ya.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau dah tak sakit tekak lepas tiga hari, boleh stop tak?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jangan stop. Kalau stop awal, kuman tak mati semua, boleh datang balik, dan jadi resistant kepada antibiotic.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Faham. Boleh makan sebelum atau selepas makan?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Amoxicillin boleh dua-dua. Tapi kalau perut tak selesa, take it after food. Jarakkan lebih kurang lapan jam.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Encik, saya nak tanya sikit. Saya makan pil perancang. Antibiotic ni kurangkan kesan pil ke? Kawan saya kata macam tu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Soalan bagus. Untuk amoxicillin, kajian terkini tunjuk tak kurangkan kesan pil. Yang betul-betul berinteraksi, rifampicin, untuk TB.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, lega sikit saya dengar.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tapi kalau cik muntah dalam tiga jam lepas makan pil, atau severe diarrhoea, pil tu mungkin tak diserap. Masa tu guna kondom tujuh hari.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada kesan sampingan amoxicillin?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kadang-kadang cirit-birit sikit, atau loya. Kalau keluar ruam gatal, bengkak bibir, atau susah bernafas, stop dan pergi klinik segera. Itu alahan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya tak pernah alahan ubat. Dulu pernah makan antibiotic OK je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Untuk sakit tekak, boleh makan paracetamol 1 gram, sampai empat kali sehari, dan kumur air garam suam.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Lozenges boleh ambil tak?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh. Saya ada yang ada ubat bius sikit, bantu kurangkan sakit bila telan. One lozenge every three hours.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK, saya ambil satu kotak. Thank you, encik.

condition: Pharmacy counselling on weekly methotrexate for rheumatoid arthritis

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Grace Chin Mei Lin, 52, female, secondary school principal in Kuching, Sarawak, newly started on methotrexate. Precise, attentive, takes notes.

doctor_persona.description: Mr. Ahmad Nazri bin Abdullah, Malay man in his 40s, senior pharmacist at a Kuching hospital. Careful, calm; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mrs. Chin, this is methotrexate 2.5mg tablets. Your dose is 10mg, which is four tablets, taken once a week only. Not every day.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Once a week. Which day is best?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Choose a fixed day. Many people choose Sunday. Let's write it on the box: "Sunday only". Kalau termakan setiap hari, very dangerous.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sunday only. I'll set a reminder on my phone.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. This is folic acid 5mg. Take one tablet once a week, but not on the same day as methotrexate. Maybe Wednesday.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Why folic acid?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It reduces side effects like mouth ulcers and nausea, without affecting how methotrexate works on your joints.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: What side effects should I watch for?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mild nausea, tiredness the day after. More serious: demam, sakit tekak, ulser mulut, lebam tanpa sebab, or cough and breathlessness. Then stop and call the clinic.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I have a school trip next month, lawatan ke Semenanjung. Can I take my usual flu vaccine before that?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The flu injection is fine. Avoid live vaccines like yellow fever or oral typhoid. Always tell doctors you're on methotrexate.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Any alcohol restriction? I sometimes have wine at dinners, majlis rasmi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Best to avoid, or very minimal, sebab dua-dua beri kesan pada hati. You'll have blood tests every two to four weeks at first, for liver and blood counts.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Are there medicines I should avoid?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Avoid trimethoprim or Bactrim antibiotics, and be careful with anti-inflammatory painkillers. Beli apa-apa ubat, always tell the pharmacist.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: And pregnancy? Not planning, just asking.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Methotrexate harms a developing baby, so reliable contraception is needed. Anyway, you mentioned you're menopausal, so less of a concern.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Terima kasih. This is very clear, better than the leaflet.

patient_persona.description: Puan Rosnani binti Ahmad, 49, female, primary school teacher in Kuala Lumpur with recurrent gallstone attacks. Anxious, asks about recovery time and fasting.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chandran a/l Muniandy, Malaysian Indian man in his 40s, general surgeon at a KL hospital. Clear, reassuring; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Rosnani, esok pagi puan dijadualkan untuk pembedahan buang pundi hempedu, laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Saya nak terangkan sebelum puan tandatangan borang.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Saya dah tiga kali masuk emergency sebab sakit perut kanan atas, lepas makan berminyak.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Betul. Gallstones dalam pundi hempedu sebabkan sakit tu. Kalau tak buang, boleh jadi jangkitan, atau pankreas radang, pancreatitis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Macam mana pembedahan tu?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita buat empat lubang kecil kat perut, masukkan kamera, dan keluarkan pundi hempedu. Puan akan tidur penuh, general anaesthesia.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tanpa pundi hempedu, saya boleh hidup normal ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh. Hati tetap buat hempedu. Ada sesetengah orang cirit-birit sikit after fatty meals, usually settles in a few weeks.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Risiko apa yang ada, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Risiko biasa: pendarahan, jangkitan luka, dan sakit bahu sebab gas. Risiko jarang, kecederaan saluran hempedu, lebih kurang satu dalam lima ratus.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kadang-kadang, kalau keadaan dalam perut sukar, we have to convert to open surgery, luka besar sikit.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau tukar ke luka besar, lama lah baru baik?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, mungkin duduk wad tiga ke lima hari. Kalau laparoscopy biasa, satu atau dua hari je.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Puasa dari pukul berapa?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Nil by mouth after midnight ni. Air kosong boleh minum sampai pukul enam pagi. Ubat darah tinggi pagi esok, makan dengan sikit air.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya ada makan aspirin, doktor klinik bagi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Anaesthetist dah semak, aspirin puan untuk pencegahan je, dah stop seminggu lepas. Bagus.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Berapa lama cuti sakit? MC berapa hari?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dua minggu MC. Tak boleh angkat berat empat minggu. Kalau tak ada soalan lain, you can sign here.

patient_persona.description: Mr. Loh Kim Seng, 71, male, retired goldsmith in Kampar, Perak, with a dense cataract in the right eye. Hard of hearing, sceptical of surgery, speaks Cantonese-flavoured Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ain Nabila binti Rosli, Malay woman in her 30s, ophthalmology medical officer at an Ipoh hospital. Patient, speaks loudly and slowly; English with Mandarin and Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Uncle Loh, 你的右眼 cataract, 白内障, is already very thick. You're scheduled for surgery next Tuesday.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我看报纸看不到，开车晚上也看不清楚。可是我怕 operation 以后会瞎掉。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Very understandable. 这个手术很普遍, more than 95 percent get better vision. Serious complications are rare.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要怎么做？会痛吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We use eye drops and a small injection to numb the eye. 你是醒着的, but no pain. We make a small cut, remove the cloudy lens, and put a new plastic lens.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要多久？要 admit 吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: About twenty to thirty minutes. Day care, 早上来, go home the same day.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有什么 risk？我朋友说有人开完以后眼睛 infection。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Risks include infection, 大概一千个人一个, bleeding, raised eye pressure, or needing a second operation. Very rarely, loss of vision.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 一千个里面一个……好啦，那还可以。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Some people get a cloudy membrane months later, 用 laser 就可以. And you'll still need reading glasses after.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我有吃 aspirin，还有降血压的药。要停吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: No need to stop aspirin for cataract surgery. 降血压的药照常吃, on the morning of the surgery.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 做完以后要注意什么？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Eye drops four times a day for one month. 晚上戴 eye shield 一个礼拜. Don't rub the eye, no swimming, avoid dust.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我可以洗头吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Can, but ask your family to help, 头向后仰, so no water goes into the eye. First week, better be careful.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我明白了。那个 form 我现在签，我儿子会先读给我听。

condition: Pre-operative consent for total knee replacement

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Parvathy a/p Nadarajan, 68, female, retired nurse in Seremban, severe osteoarthritis of the left knee. Experienced with hospitals, direct questions, some Malay and Tamil-accented English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chia Wei Hong, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, orthopaedic surgeon at a Seremban hospital. Frank, confident; English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mrs. Parvathy, you're booked for a left total knee replacement next week. Let's go through the consent properly, even though you know hospitals well.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Please, doctor. Working in the ward lain, being the patient lain. I'm a bit nervous, takut juga.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Understandable. We'll replace the worn joint surfaces with metal and plastic parts. You'll have a spinal anaesthetic, numb from the waist down, with sedation.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: How long will the new knee last?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: About ninety percent still working well after fifteen to twenty years. Weight control helps it last longer.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: What are the main risks?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Infection, around one percent, which may need more surgery. Blood clots in the legs, which is why you'll get blood thinner injections. Stiffness, and some ongoing pain in about one in ten.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: One in ten still got pain? Hmm, that's quite a lot, banyak juga tu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, but most of those are still better than before surgery. I want you to have realistic expectations.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My sugar tak berapa baik, HbA1c 8.1. Is that a problem?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It raises infection risk, risiko jangkitan naik. Your physician agreed to adjust your insulin. We'd prefer below 8, but 8.1 is acceptable. Jaga gula betul-betul minggu ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. After surgery, berapa lama duduk wad?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Usually three to five days. Physio will get you standing the next day. Walking frame for about six weeks, then a stick.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My house got stairs, and a squatting toilet at the back, tandas cangkung.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Can you sleep downstairs for a while? And please get a commode chair or toilet seat raiser. Jangan mencangkung sekurang-kurangnya tiga bulan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, my son will arrange. Bila boleh drive?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Left knee and automatic car, maybe four to six weeks. Any other questions before you sign?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, you've been very clear. Terima kasih, doktor.

condition: Pre-operative consent for elective inguinal hernia repair

patient_persona.description: Encik Zulkifli bin Hamzah, 55, male, fisherman from Kuala Besut, Terengganu, with a right inguinal hernia for two years. Jovial, worried about time off work, strong Terengganu accent softened.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Tan Xin Yi, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, surgical medical officer at a Terengganu hospital. Friendly, straightforward; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Zulkifli, esok encik akan buat pembedahan hernia sebelah kanan. Saya nak terangkan dulu sebelum tandatangan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Benda ni dah dua tahun, makin besar, especially when I pull the net, angkat pukat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita akan tolak balik usus ke dalam, dan letak mesh, jaring khas, untuk kuatkan dinding perut. Buat melalui satu luka kat pangkal peha.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Jaring tu kekal dalam badan ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, kekal. Badan akan tumbuh tisu di sekelilingnya. Ia kurangkan risiko hernia datang balik.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kena tidur penuh ke, doktor? General anaesthesia?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh bius separuh badan, spinal, atau bius penuh. Anaesthetist akan bincang dengan encik petang ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Risikonya apa?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sakit dan lebam kat kawasan luka, jangkitan, kebas kulit sekitar luka. Kadang-kadang sakit berpanjangan. Hernia berulang, lebih kurang satu hingga lima peratus.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau tak buat, apa jadi?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hernia boleh tersepit, usus tersekat. Itu kecemasan, lebih bahaya. Sebab tu lebih baik buat secara terancang.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bila saya boleh pergi laut balik? Musim ikan dah nak mula.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Light work after two weeks. Kerja berat macam angkat pukat, tunggu enam minggu. Sorry, encik.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Enam minggu? Aduh, anak saya kena ganti lah ni, dia kena turun laut.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Lebih baik sembuh betul-betul daripada hernia datang balik. Malam ni lepas pukul dua belas jangan makan dan minum.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Rokok pun tak boleh ke? Saya hisap sebatang dua.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Best to stop, sekurang-kurangnya sampai luka baik. Smoking slows healing and increases infection risk.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baiklah doktor, saya cuba. Mana nak tandatangan?

condition: Pre-operative consent for appendicectomy in a teenager, parent consenting

patient_persona.description: Mdm. Kok Mei Ling, 42, female, mother of Kok Jun Wei, 14, who has acute appendicitis; bakery owner in Sandakan, Sabah. Anxious, fast-speaking, asks many questions.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Hafizuddin bin Jalil, Malay man in his 30s, surgical medical officer at a Sandakan hospital. Calm, direct; English with Mandarin and Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Kok, Jun Wei's scan confirms appendicitis, 盲肠炎. He needs surgery tonight. Since he's under eighteen, we need your consent.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 今天晚上就要 operation？不能吃药就好吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For some mild cases, antibiotics alone can work. But his appendix is swollen with a stone inside, 很可能会爆. Surgery is safer.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 如果 burst 了会怎样？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Infection spreads in the whole tummy, peritonitis, 腹膜炎. More serious, longer hospital stay, sometimes need second surgery.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好……那要怎样开？大伤口吗？Big wound?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Keyhole, laparoscopic. 三个小伤口, one at the belly button. Full general anaesthesia, he'll be asleep throughout.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 麻醉对小孩子 safe 吗？他以前没有开过刀。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Very safe for a healthy fourteen-year-old. The anaesthetist will see him before surgery and ask about allergies.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有什么风险？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Wound infection, bleeding, and an abscess inside the tummy, 尤其是发炎很严重的话. Rarely, injury to the bowel.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要住院多少天？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If no burst, 一到两天. If burst, maybe five to seven days, with antibiotic drip.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 他下个礼拜有 exam，可以去吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If all goes well, he can go to school after one week, but no sports or PJ 两到四个礼拜.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 他现在还可以吃东西吗？他说很饿。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: No, nothing to eat or drink from now, 现在开始不能吃. We'll give drip for fluids, and painkiller through the vein.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我签。医生，请好好照顾他。
